authorization: User authorized three individual additions to the refitted liquidation model, blended with the existing RF. Optimize MAE; track Spearman only.
change_scope: Add one feature to median regression only; reuse and replay unchanged two-feature RF models. Re-select weights using earlier inner validation only.
fit_accounting: 3 candidates x 4 folds x (inner median regression + weight selection + outer median regression) = 36 counted steps, 24 new model fits; zero RF fits.
promotion_rule: After replay verification, the strictly lowest same-population MAE becomes the new development benchmark; prefer incumbent on exact ties. Retain all old results. Nominal uncertainty must be reported separately.
selection_exposure: PDF ranking and previous model results were inspected. Feature selection is historical development selection, not untouched confirmation.
stopping_rule: Run the three additions only. No combinations or additional tuning before their results are assessed.
horizon_reuse: Target horizon, label-end column, input paths, folds and benchmark are explicit. Other horizons require matching target labels and separately generated/verified pair anchors and benchmark predictions. Never reuse 48h target/model artifacts for another horizon; no other horizons run in this experiment.
